content.value_statement: Working with Google Sheets APIs can require many resources, methods, and flags. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code inspect and use gws sheet commands.
actual_capabilities: Shows the base gws sheets command pattern for resources, methods, and flags.
Lists helper commands for appending rows and reading spreadsheet values.
Summarizes spreadsheet methods such as create, get, getByDataFilter, and batchUpdate.
Identifies spreadsheet resources including developerMetadata, sheets, and values.
Directs users to inspect method schemas before building params and JSON flags.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and configured Google Workspace authentication.
Does not include full parameter schemas for every Sheets API method.
Does not execute spreadsheet actions without the underlying CLI command.
User permissions and Google API quotas still control successful requests.

use_cases.title: Prepare spreadsheet updates
use_cases.description: Plan the correct gws sheets resource and method before updating a workbook.

use_cases.title: Inspect API method requirements
use_cases.description: Use schema discovery to understand required parameters before calling a Sheets method.

use_cases.title: Read and append sheet data
use_cases.description: Find helper commands for reading values and appending rows to spreadsheets.

prompt_templates.title: Find the right command
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose the correct gws sheets resource and method for reading values from a spreadsheet.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect method parameters
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to inspect the schema for a Google Sheets method before I build the command flags.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a spreadsheet creation workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating a spreadsheet with gws sheets and checking which parameters are required.

prompt_templates.title: Design a batch update plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a safe batchUpdate workflow, including schema inspection and validation before applying changes.

output_examples.input: I need to read values from a Google Sheet.
output_examples.output: The skill points you to the read helper and the values resource, then recommends schema inspection before sending parameters.

output_examples.input: I want to create a new spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the create method under spreadsheets and suggests checking its schema before building the request.

output_examples.input: I need to update several spreadsheet settings together.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights batchUpdate and explains that Google validates all requests before applying the update group.

best_practices: Inspect the relevant method schema before preparing params or JSON flags.
Confirm the spreadsheet ID and target resource before running write operations.
Use helper commands for common read and append tasks when they match the workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not run write methods against production spreadsheets without reviewing parameters first.
Do not assume grid data is returned unless the request explicitly asks for it.
Do not skip authentication and permission checks when troubleshooting failed requests.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps users navigate gws commands for Google Sheets resources, methods, and schema discovery.

faq.question: Does it require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The underlying gws CLI needs valid Google Workspace authentication and permissions.

faq.question: Can it append rows to a spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists an append helper command for adding rows to a spreadsheet.

faq.question: Can it read spreadsheet values?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists a read helper command and the values resource for spreadsheet data.

faq.question: Does it include every method parameter?
faq.answer: No. It tells users to inspect schemas with gws before building command flags.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that use the gws CLI.
